newsitem.title: FRANCE: Vallourec up on more rumours.
newsitem.headline: Vallourec up on more rumours.

text.p: Shares in French steel tube manufacturer Vallourec closed 3.61 percent higher as resurgent rumours that chief shareholder Usinor would sell its stake worked their way through the market, analysts said.
A Vallourec official acknowledged the existence of takeover rumours in the market but refused to comment on them.
He noted that Vallourec general managing director Jean-Claude Verdiere had said last week that "Vallourec was not for sale."
The official also said that any takeover of the company could not happen through the bourse since Usinor controls about 28 percent of Vallourec's capital and some 43 percent of the voting rights.
"Any takeover would have to go through the office of Mr (Usinor Chairman Francis) Mer," the official said.
A Usinor spokeswoman declined to comment on the rumours.
